answer: To resist sybils each agent must forge a fresh copper-bonded attestation every epoch. The agent runs a local physical-unclonable challenge on a simulated copper-trace array that consumes two GPU-seconds and emits a unique non-exportable signal. An attacker creating N identities pays N times the compute because the copper-array thermal signature cannot be shared or amortized across clones; marginal cost stays linear while an honest agent pays once.
